body:
Read from github.com/deevus/pi-zmx at HEAD, 2026-11-05. MIT, npm @deevus/pi-zmx 0.1.1, last pushed 2026-05. Not run. One file, extensions/zmx-exec.ts.

- ensureSession: `zmx list --short`, then `zmx run NAME true`, as d-install assumed, with a 10s timeout.
- zmx_run is synchronous with a default 30s timeout, despite the README saying non-blocking. Whether pi's timeout signals only the child or its tree is not established; a task past it meets e-host-probes item 7.
- Default session name is the pi session name lowercased with everything outside [\w-] stripped, so it can never hold a dot and is never labelled. A dotted name needs an explicit `session` parameter.
- With no zmx on PATH it registers all six tools as stubs that report the failure. A jail without zmx would carry six dead tools.
- zmx_attach only prints instructions. It is the natural `blocked` writer and writes nothing.
- Peer dependency @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent. Compatibility with host pi 1.4.0 is unverified.

Install state: neither ~/.pi/agent/settings.json nor ~/agent_home/.pi/agent/settings.json lists it. Both are plain files and their package lists are hand-duplicated.
title: pi-zmx as it actually is
